dct_description_sm:
Data is regularly collected in the Welland Recreational Canal from the boathouse docks. Water quality data are collected using tools in the Water Rangers Freshwater Explorer testkit, including portable probes and test strips, conductivity meter, secchi disc, and dissolved oxygen tests. Long term trends are tracked and logged on the Water Rangers data platform. 
The group also collects data from the Humber River at Magwood Sanctuary.
